adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Calendar.createEvent` to be invoked as `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts) so calendar services must select the correct destination calendar based on the passed `credentialId` from the now-array `event.destinationCalendar`. GoogleCalendarService was updated to `find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`, but LarkCalendarService was not: it still defines `async createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and picks `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;` (packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). With the new multi-destination flow (EventManager creates events per destination calendar; handleNewBooking can push multiple team destination calendars for COLLECTIVE), calls using another host’s Lark credential will still target the first destination calendar’s `externalId`, potentially calling Lark API against a calendar the credential doesn’t own and failing or writing to the wrong calendar.
